The SpongeAPI 8 update removes/relocates several command-related classes used here:
- CommandSource removed; replaced by CommandCause (and Audience).
- CommandContext moved from org.spongepowered.api.command.args to org.spongepowered.api.command.parameter.CommandContext.
- CommandExecutor moved from org.spongepowered.api.command.spec.CommandExecutor to org.spongepowered.api.command.CommandExecutor with a new execute signature.
- CommandSpec removed; replaced by Command and Command.Parameterized via Command.builder().
- Argument builders moved from GenericArguments to Parameter.
- Text.of replaced by Kyori Adventure Components (not used directly here).

To adapt:
- Update imports to new packages.
- Change execute signature to use CommandCause and new CommandContext.
- Use Parameter API for argument definition and retrieval.
- Replace Player with ServerPlayer (Sponge 8).
- Replace messages to use cause.audience() for sending.
- Replace buildSpec to return Command.Parameterized and build using Command.builder with addParameter.

These changes are minimal and align with Sponge 8’s command framework, ensuring compilation.

package com.github.games647.changeskin.sponge.command;

import com.github.games647.changeskin.sponge.ChangeSkinSponge;
import com.github.games647.changeskin.sponge.PomData;
import com.github.games647.changeskin.sponge.task.SkinSelector;
import com.google.inject.Inject;

import org.spongepowered.api.command.Command;
import org.spongepowered.api.command.CommandCause;
import org.spongepowered.api.command.CommandExecutor;
import org.spongepowered.api.command.CommandResult;
import org.spongepowered.api.command.parameter.CommandContext;
import org.spongepowered.api.command.parameter.Parameter;
import org.spongepowered.api.entity.living.player.server.ServerPlayer;
import org.spongepowered.api.scheduler.Task;

import java.util.Locale;

public class SelectCommand implements CommandExecutor, ChangeSkinCommand {

    private static final Parameter.Value<String> SKIN_NAME = Parameter.string().key("skinName").build();

    private final ChangeSkinSponge plugin;

    @Inject
    SelectCommand(ChangeSkinSponge plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public CommandResult execute(CommandCause cause, CommandContext context) {
        ServerPlayer receiver = cause.first(ServerPlayer.class).orElse(null);
        if (receiver == null) {
            plugin.sendMessage(cause.audience(), "no-console");
            return CommandResult.empty();
        }

        String skinName = context.requireOne(SKIN_NAME).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replace("skin-", "");

        try {
            int targetId = Integer.parseInt(skinName);
            Task.builder().async().execute(new SkinSelector(plugin, receiver, targetId)).submit(plugin);
        } catch (NumberFormatException numberFormatException) {
            plugin.sendMessage(cause.audience(), "invalid-skin-name");
        }

        return CommandResult.success();
    }

    @Override
    public Command.Parameterized buildSpec() {
        return Command.builder()
                .executor(this)
                .addParameter(SKIN_NAME)
                .permission(PomData.ARTIFACT_ID + ".command.skinselect.base")
                .build();
    }
}
